title: Quarterly maximum leverage with remote definition

agreement.pdf.source_wording: The Borrower shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio as of any fiscal quarter end to exceed 3.50:1.00.
conditions: as of any fiscal quarter end

referenced_definitions.definition_text: Total Leverage Ratio means Total Debt divided by EBITDA for the applicable Testing Period.
Testing Period means each period of four consecutive fiscal quarters.
